zh-CN.title: 国子监
zh-CN.subtitle: 经典教育与国家知识制度的机构入口
zh-CN.shortSummary: 国子监使《五经》、经学注疏、考试和国家教育制度进入同一条可追踪的机构线索。
curatorialDescription: 从国子监出发，观众可以把孔颖达和《五经正义》放回制度环境，而不是只看成个人学术成就。
机构条目保留教育与政治功能的双重性，具体校舍、官职和制度沿革需要按时期拆分。
zh-CN.researchNote: 需要核对唐代国子监的制度沿革、具体地点、课程和《五经正义》的编纂与传播关系。

en.title: Guozijian
en.subtitle: An institutional entry into classical education and state knowledge
en.shortSummary: The Guozijian connects the Five Classics, commentary, examination and state education within a traceable institutional line.
curatorialDescription: Starting from the Guozijian places Kong Yingda and the Corrected Meanings within an institutional setting rather than presenting them only as individual scholarship.
The record keeps the institution's educational and political functions visible; buildings, offices and reforms require period-specific records.
en.researchNote: Tang institutional changes, exact location, curriculum and the compilation and circulation of the Corrected Meanings still need verification.
